title: Next milestone after candidate nomination
context: A program has nominated an optimized development candidate that meets the potency, selectivity, and ADMET criteria. No human or GLP studies have been done yet.
decision_required: What is the immediate next stage of development? Finish with a DECISION block: verdict: <ind_enabling_studies | first_in_human | lead_optimization | nda_filing>.

evidence.note: After candidate selection the next stage is IND-enabling studies (GLP toxicology + CMC/GMP + nonclinical package) — you cannot dose humans before IND-enabling tox and an IND.

source: Standard drug-development pipeline (FDA/ICH). Structural sequence — objective.

title: IND prerequisites
context: A sponsor wants to file an Investigational New Drug (IND) application to begin first-in-human testing.
decision_required: Which of these must be completed BEFORE filing the IND: GLP toxicology; CMC/manufacturing; the nonclinical pharmacology/PK package; the clinical (Phase 1) protocol; Phase 2 efficacy data; the NDA? Finish with a line: required: <comma-separated items>.

evidence.note: IND package = GLP tox + CMC + nonclinical pharmacology/PK (CTD §2.6) + the Phase 1 clinical protocol. Phase 2 efficacy and the NDA come years later — distractors.

source: FDA IND content (21 CFR 312) / CTD. Objective.

title: CMC vs GLP tox — parallel or sequential?
context: During IND-enabling work, a team is planning timelines for GLP toxicology and CMC/formulation + GMP manufacturing.
decision_required: Is CMC/manufacturing run strictly AFTER GLP toxicology completes, or IN PARALLEL with it? Finish with a DECISION block: verdict: <parallel | sequential>.

evidence.note: CMC/GMP manufacturing and GLP toxicology run in PARALLEL during IND-enabling to compress timelines; they are not strictly sequential.

source: Standard program management (parallel IND-enabling workstreams). Objective at the structural level.

title: Can Phase III precede Phase I?
context: A sponsor asks whether they can launch a large confirmatory Phase III efficacy trial before any Phase I human safety/PK data exist.
decision_required: Can a confirmatory Phase III trial begin before any Phase I human safety data exist? Finish with a DECISION block: verdict: <no | yes>.

evidence.note: Human testing starts at Phase I (safety/PK) under an IND; Phase III is confirmatory and comes after Phase I and II. The sequence is a hard regulatory gate.

title: Primary objective of Phase I
context: A first-in-human oncology trial is being designed.
decision_required: What is the PRIMARY objective of a Phase I trial? Finish with a DECISION block: verdict: <safety_mtd_pk | efficacy_proof_of_concept | confirmatory_efficacy>.

evidence.note: Phase I = safety, tolerability, MTD, PK (and often dose escalation). Efficacy proof-of-concept is Phase II; confirmatory efficacy is Phase III.

title: Which regulatory milestone is next?
context: A program has completed GLP toxicology, assembled the nonclinical pharmacology/PK package, finished CMC for the clinical supply, and is drafting the Phase 1 clinical protocol to begin human testing.
decision_required: Which regulatory milestone comes next? Finish with a DECISION block: verdict: <ind_filing | nda_filing | candidate_selection | phase_ii_start>.

evidence.note: With GLP tox + nonclinical package + CMC + Phase 1 protocol in hand, the next milestone is filing the IND, which clears first-in-human dosing. The NDA is after Phase III.

source: FDA IND / clinical development sequence. Objective.
